GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.5 (28 Nov 45) LS
(SCAPIN - 357)
28 November 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Personnel of Prisoner of War Management.
A list of personnel comprising the chain of command of the Prisoner of War Management will be prepared and submitted to this headquarters not later than 14 December 1945. This list will include respective positions and dates of office since1 January 1942, and will begin with War Ministers and include Chiefs of Prisoner of War Management, Commander of Army Districts, Navy Prisoner of War District Camp Personnel, Chiefs of Prisoner of War Information Bureau, Chiefs of Gendarme Corps, Temporary and Formal Prisoner of War Camps.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
